config.question: Which eligible former Avalanche players have the closest observed NHL careers to the November 10, 2026 roster, through 2025-26?
config.scope: Entire NHL careers; alumni eligibility only counts Colorado team 21 from 1995-96 onward. Quebec-only players excluded; Quebec seasons of qualifying alumni remain in full NHL careers.
config.interpretation: Exploratory descriptive analogues, not predictions or measures of defensive value or causal effects.

goalie_saved.seconds_source: NHL Web landing timeOnIce; exact source disagreements are retained in the audit, not averaged.

definition.threshold: Start with save percentage greater than .900, per NHL published explanation; fixed threshold is not era-neutral.
